The Pell grant program is primarily a discretionary program, with an annual appropriation supporting a maximum award set in the annual appropriation act. CBO's March 2020 baseline does not represent a projection of expected costs for the Pell grant program. As with all other discretionary programs, the budget authority is calculated by inflating the budget authority appropriated for fiscal year 2020. Outlays for future years are based on those amounts of budget authority. In the most recently enacted appropriations act, the maximum award was set at $5,285. CBO's March 2020 baseline does not assume a maximum award for future fiscal years.
